Removed DynamicCelestial class as the first step to finalizing the data structure for astronomicals to separate vehicles from the Celestial class. As part of this the ManeuverPlan instances moves to the FlightComputer and the FlightPlan instances moves to the Vehicle class.

Refactored texture import process to support compressed texture formats (credit: Froce on discord for reminding me to do this). This is a pretty significant change with some significant impacts. Currently rescaling of DDS is not supported, and BRUTAL team are now looking into KTX2 support. This means DDS will not be affected by config changes to texture size. However, terrain heightmaps are almost always not compressed so this won't be affected. Lots more to come on this, but at the extreme for the solar system on full unscaled, the VRAM usage went from 12-14 GB to 6-7 GB.

Added compressed texture handling for heightmap lookup on the CPU. Whether this should be supported is a good question, but it seemed necessary architecture wise to refactor this to take into account the actual byte alignment.
